parameters.name: DedicatedHostGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the dedicated cluster.

> Specify at least one of the **VpcId** and **DedicatedHostGroupId** parameters.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 50. The default value is 50.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the vSwitch belongs.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the vSwitch belongs.

> Specify at least one of the **VpcId** and **DedicatedHostGroupId** parameters.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the vSwitch.
